svg.title: Model Training Workstream (WS2) - SigLIP 2 + MobileNetV4 Two-Model Pipeline

g.text: Model Training Workstream (WS2) - SigLIP 2 + MobileNetV4 Two-Model Pipeline
G2: Script (3 heads: script_code cls + has_non_latin + has_rtl)
G3: Orientation+Skew (3 heads: orientation_cls + skew_reg + confidence)
G4: Handwriting (5 heads: 3 cls presence/legibility/content_type + 2 reg scores)
G5: Page Attrs (5 heads: capture_cls + shadow/warping/code/resolution_quality reg)
- Skew MAE < 0.5 deg; >= 90% within 0.5 deg of GT
- Total: ~22 hours on Modal A10 GPU
3-Step Virtuous Training Cycle | ~503K images across 10 datasets | See: layout-fusion-downsampler.md (LEGACY fallback)
